qualification.details: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government / State Govt. / UT Administration / PSUs / Universities / recognized Research Institutions / Semi-Government or Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Organization; (i) Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre / department; OR (ii) five years' regular service in the grade in Pay Band-3 Rs.15600-39100 with Grade Pay Rs.7600 or equivalent; OR (iii) ten years' regular service in Pay Band-3 Rs.15600-39100 plus Grade Pay Rs.6600 or equivalent; Degree in Architecture from a recognized University / Institute; Registered with the Council of Architecture Experience: 11 years' experience in Government Organizations / Department / PSU / Autonomous Institution Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of application) | Other conditions: | Applicant must be an officer of Central / State Govt., UT Administration, PSU, University, recognized Research Institution, Semi-Government, Autonomous or Statutory body Applicant must be able to be relieved immediately on selection Must be registered with the Council of Architecture | Desirable: | Post Graduate Degree in Architecture or Degree or Diploma in Town / City / Urban / Regional Planning from a recognized University One year experience in Town Planning / Civic Designing / Building Control Regulations Fellowship of the Indian Institute of Architect or membership of a professional Institute Six months Certificate / Diploma Course in Auto Cad, Archi Cad, Revit

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level-13 (Rs.123100-215900) plus DA, Special Compensatory Allowance, Island Special Allowance and deputation allowance as admissible

how_to_apply: Obtain the application form from the Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram, or download it from andamannicobar.gov.in or www.apwd.and.nic.in.
Fill the bio-data in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) in duplicate and sign it.
Attach vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, statement of penalty and ACRs of the last five years.
Get the application forwarded through proper channel by the employer.
Application must reach the Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram within 60 days from the date of publication of the Vacancy Notice.
Make sure it reaches by 18 January 2027.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications and those without the complete set of essential documents shall be rejected Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature Selected officer shall not be allowed to withdraw or refuse to join Sponsoring authority must release the selected officer within a month of the appointment letter / order

content_sections.heading: A&N Administration Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. 2-65(A)/2020-PWD)/753 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download A&N Administration notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government / State Govt. / UT Administration / PSUs / Universities / recognized Research Institutions / Semi-Government or Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Organization; (i) Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre / department; OR (ii) five years' regular service in the grade in Pay Band-3 Rs.15600-39100 with Grade Pay Rs.7600 or equivalent; OR (iii) ten years' regular service in Pay Band-3 Rs.15600-39100 plus Grade Pay Rs.6600 or equivalent; Degree in Architecture from a recognized University / Institute; Registered with the Council of Architecture Experience: 11 years' experience in Government Organizations / Department / PSU / Autonomous Institution Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of application) Other conditions: Applicant must be an officer of Central / State Govt., UT Administration, PSU, University, recognized Research Institution, Semi-Government, Autonomous or Statutory body Applicant must be able to be relieved immediately on selection Must be registered with the Council of Architecture Desirable: Post Graduate Degree in Architecture or Degree or Diploma in Town / City / Urban / Regional Planning from a recognized University One year experience in Town Planning / Civic Designing / Building Control Regulations Fellowship of the Indian Institute of Architect or membership of a professional Institute Six months Certificate / Diploma Course in Auto Cad, Archi Cad, Revit

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for A&N Administration Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Departmental Officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation (ISTC) initially for three (03) years, which may be extended in accordance with the rules Period of deputation including preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed five years (page 2); terms page says four years Option to get pay fixed in the deputation post or draw parent-post pay plus deputation allowance

content_sections.heading: How Will A&N Administration Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Assessment of the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee The CV and documents on Essential Qualification / Work Experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bio-data in the prescribed Proforma (Annexure-I) in duplicate, signed and forwarded through proper channel Vigilance clearance certificate Integrity certificate Statement of penalty (Major / Minor) imposed, if any ACR dossier or ACRs for the last five years; photocopies attested on each page by an officer not below Under Secretary rank Cadre Clearance, for officers already on deputation

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for A&N Administration Recruitment 2027 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form from the Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram, or download it from andamannicobar.gov.in or www.apwd.and.nic.in. Fill the bio-data in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) in duplicate and sign it. Attach vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, statement of penalty and ACRs of the last five years. Get the application forwarded through proper channel by the employer. Application must reach the Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram within 60 days from the date of publication of the Vacancy Notice. Make sure it reaches by 18 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications and those without the complete set of essential documents shall be rejected Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature Selected officer shall not be allowed to withdraw or refuse to join Sponsoring authority must release the selected officer within a month of the appointment letter / order

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for A&N Administration Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in A&N Administration Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Sr. Architect.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for A&N Administration Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of this notice; Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD; https:/andamannicobar.gov.in or www.apwd.and.nic.in) and send it to Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram, A & N Islands, Pin- 744101, by forwarded through proper channel by the employer, to reach by 18 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level-13 (Rs.123100-215900) plus DA, Special Compensatory Allowance, Island Special Allowance and deputation allowance as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree in Architecture from a recognized University / Institute, 11 years' experience in Government Organizations / Department / PSU / Autonomous Institution, and registration with the Council of Architecture; plus holding an analogous post or the prescribed regular service in Pay Band-3 (Grade Pay Rs.7600 for five years or Rs.6600 for ten years) or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be an officer of Central / State Govt., UT Administration, PSU, University, recognized Research Institution, Semi-Government, Autonomous or Statutory body. Applicant must be able to be relieved immediately on selection. Must be registered with the Council of Architecture.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental Officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment of the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee. The CV and documents on Essential Qualification / Work Experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation (ISTC) initially for three (03) years, which may be extended in accordance with the rules. Period of deputation including preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed five years (page 2); terms page says four years. Option to get pay fixed in the deputation post or draw parent-post pay plus deputation allowance.
